name: SWGO
summary: Proposed wide-field gamma-ray observatory in the Southern Hemisphere, enabling long-term observations of the Galactic center and high-energy dark-matter targets.
physics_targets: Indirect searches for heavy dark matter
detection_principle: A large area of ground water-Cherenkov detectors samples air showers, providing a wide field of view and high duty cycle.

status.label: Announced plan
status.evidence: The 2024 site-selection announcement anticipated construction beginning in 2026; no independent evidence of a formal construction start was obtained in this review.

timeline.event: Announcement of the Pampa La Bola site in Chile

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
